message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a stylized cover with bold text and three figures around a table. At the top, "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters over a mustard-yellow background. Below it, the white text reads "BARA DALAM SEKAM" and "JOKOWI-MEGA" in larger, blocky letters. Further down, several lines of smaller white text appear. In the top red and mustard sections, smaller headlines include "Korupsi Dana Sawit Mengalir Jauh H.62" and "Kartu Merah TikTok Shop H.79".

The central illustration depicts three individuals in a high-contrast room. On the left, a man with white hair, shown in profile, wears a red long-sleeved shirt and rests his arms on a white table. Facing him is a woman with dark hair and glasses, wearing a black top with a red stripe across the chest, her hands folded. To the right, only the back and side of a standing figure in a light-blue or white shirt and dark trousers are visible, with one hand resting on a black chair. A glass coffee carafe containing dark liquid sits on the white tabletop. The bottom right corner contains publication details, a barcode, and a QR code.
